listeningQuestions.audio: To have a balanced life is the best way to fight stress.
opts: 拥有平衡的生活是应对压力的最佳方式。
只有考试才会带来压力。

listeningQuestions.audio: A little stress before a test can actually help you focus.
opts: 考前的一点压力会让你失败。
考前的一点压力其实能帮你集中注意力。
压力在任何时候都有害。

listeningQuestions.audio: Breathe in slowly through your nose to calm yourself down.
opts: 大声喊叫才能冷静下来。
用鼻子慢慢吸气让自己平静下来。

listeningQuestions.audio: Talking to someone you trust can make your worries feel lighter.
opts: 向你信任的人倾诉能让担忧变轻。

listeningQuestions.audio: Getting enough sleep helps you handle stress much better.
opts: 充足的睡眠能帮你更好地应对压力。

listeningQuestions.audio: Doing some exercise can lift your mood very quickly.
opts: 做些运动能很快提升你的心情。

quizQuestions.q: Too much ____ can make you feel sick and tired.（压力）
She felt great ____ before the important exam.（焦虑）
Relaxation can help reduce ____ thoughts and worry.（消极的）
Getting enough sleep helps you ____ stress.（应对）
____ a balanced life is the best way to stay calm.
John's plan is ____ some volunteer work this weekend.
____ is necessary to share your feelings with others.
The best way to relax is ____ slowly and deeply.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 承认自己有压力是勇敢的表现。
绝不要承认自己有压力。
quizQuestions.audio: It is brave to admit that you feel stressed.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 我最喜欢的放松方式是去跑步。
quizQuestions.audio: My favourite way to relax is to go for a run.

reading.passage: When David felt stressed before his exams, he started going to bed earlier and taking a short walk every afternoon. These small changes helped him sleep better and worry less, and soon he felt ready to face his tests with a calmer mind.
reading.passageCn: 考试前感到压力时,David 开始早点睡觉,并每天下午散一小段步。这些小小的改变让他睡得更好、担忧更少,很快他就以更平静的心态准备迎接考试了。

questions.q: What two changes did David make?
opts: Going to bed earlier and taking a short walk.
Studying all night and skipping meals.

questions.q: How did David feel after these changes?
opts: Calmer and ready for his tests.
Too sleepy to study at all.

writing.prompt: Write a short note to a friend who feels stressed before exams. Tell them one or two ways to relax. Try to use an infinitive as a subject or predicative (e.g. To have a balanced life is the best way to stay calm).
writing.promptCn: 给一位考前感到压力的朋友写一段短信,告诉他/她一两种放松的方法。试着用不定式作主语或表语(如 To have a balanced life is …)。

lines.text: You look worried. Is everything okay?
lines.cn: 你看起来很担心,一切还好吗?

lines.text: I'm a bit stressed about my exams next week.
lines.cn: 下周的考试让我有点压力。

lines.text: To have a balanced life really helps. Don't forget to rest.
lines.cn: 拥有平衡的生活真的有帮助,别忘了休息。

lines.text: You're right. I'll try to sleep earlier tonight.
lines.cn: 你说得对,我今晚会试着早点睡。

lines.text: What do you do when you feel panicky?
lines.cn: 你惊慌的时候会怎么做?

lines.text: My favourite way to relax is to breathe slowly and deeply.
lines.cn: 我最喜欢的放松方式是缓慢深呼吸。

lines.text: Yes. After a few minutes, I always feel much calmer.
lines.cn: 有用,几分钟后我总会平静很多。
